2609.39807.title: Stress-Testing LLM Lie Detectors: Role-Play Failures and Spurious Correlations
2609.39807.paper_summary: Lie detection probes aim to predict from a language model's internal states whether its output is truthful or dishonest. However, role-play complicates what "truth" means for an LLM: language models can adopt a wide range of personas that take very different claims to be true, including personas whose beliefs clearly contradict reality, such as a conspiracy theorist. In this work, we investigate whether lie detection probes reliably flag falsehoods generated under such an anti-factual persona or whether they instead follow the persona's beliefs. We introduce a dataset of 8,916 human-reviewed, on-policy responses from three LLMs adopting anti-factual personas. Evaluating eight probes from prior work, we find that many fail in this setting, particularly when correct and incorrect answers are evaluated under the same persona prompt. To investigate why, we construct three novel confounder datasets in which truth is anti-correlated with a potential confounding concept. Our experiments reveal that many existing probes strongly track concepts that are spuriously correlated with truth in their training data, such as instruction compliance or response likelihood. Based on these findings, we introduce a simple linear probe that achieves the strongest overall performance on both the persona and confounder stress tests. Our results suggest that current lie detection probes are far from reliable and highlight the need for training data in which truth is decorrelated from confounding concepts.
2609.39807.paper_summary_zh: 謊言檢測探針旨在從語言模型的內部狀態預測其輸出是否真實或不誠實。<lb/>然而，角色扮演使得「真相」對於大型語言模型的意義變得複雜：語言模型可以採用廣泛的角色，這些角色對於什麼是真實的主張有著截然不同的看法，包括那些信念明顯與現實相矛盾的角色，例如陰謀論者。<lb/>在本研究中，我們調查謊言檢測探針是否能可靠地標記在這種反事實角色下生成的虛假陳述，或者它們是否遵循角色的信念。<lb/>我們引入了一個數據集，其中包含8916條經人類審核的、符合政策的回應，這些回應來自三個採用反事實角色的LLM。<lb/>在評估先前工作的八個探針時，我們發現許多探針在這種情境下失敗，特別是在正確和錯誤的答案在同一角色提示下進行評估時。<lb/>為了調查原因，我們構建了三個新穎的混淆數據集，其中真相與潛在的混淆概念呈反相關。<lb/>我們的實驗揭示，許多現有的探針強烈追蹤與其訓練數據中的真相虛假相關的概念，例如指令遵從性或回應可能性。<lb/>根據這些發現，我們引入了一個簡單的線性探針，該探針在角色和混淆壓力測試中達到了最強的整體性能。<lb/>我們的結果表明，當前的謊言檢測探針遠非可靠，並突顯了需要訓練數據，使得真相與混淆概念之間去相關。
